host.binding: numactl --cpunodebind=0 --membind=0 (all 48 CPUs of the single NUMA node)

command.liveness: dive check <module.tla> --config <model.cfg> --workers 1 --seed 0 --fp 0 --time-limit <max(60s, 2.5 x D1 TLC time)> --max-memory 64g --output json under GNU /usr/bin/time -v; 3 repetitions

deviations: Release binary built on one bench node and copied to the others (independent builds were not byte-identical); dive_binary_sha256 names the copied binary.

The liveness part ran on the small-class node after D5, D3 and D6 rather than straight after the benchmark-set part, because its budgets needed every D1 shard's TLC times; one measured process at a time throughout.
tlc_memory_note: TLC peak RSS depends on -Xmx3g (dive-bench --xmx 3g); it is the JVM's footprint, not TLC's minimum.
liveness_selection: Every R1 agreeing model whose config has PROPERTY or PROPERTIES was run once (the probe, at the same budget); those whose report says check_kind temporal were kept. Refinement-only and safety-reducible properties report safety and drop out.
